metadata.settings_status: Prepared and schema-validated; update PWM offset from current measured room temperature before starting.
metadata.implementation: RAW_POS implements prescribed positive-only sinusoidal PWM feedforward, without temperature feedback. OPEN in this firmware is a different inverse-calibration-table feedforward method.

calibration.qualification: Measured static curve; Module 4 settling audit remains applicable. Revalidate with the rod attached.

metadata.ambient_method: Current room temperature not yet measured or supplied.
metadata.offset_reference_note: Ua in this draft uses the historical Module 4 zero-PWM baseline 23.44 C. This is not a measurement of current room temperature.
metadata.before_start: Measure current room temperature, record it as ambient_C and recompute Ua_pwm=(35-ambient_C)/chi_heat_C_per_pwm. Reload/upload the updated file. Editing ambient metadata alone does not automatically change Ua.
metadata.duration_note: 300 simulated-firmware seconds of actual operation = three full 100 s cycles, following operator instruction to ignore settling as a repeat trigger. This duration alone does not certify a settled interval.
metadata.setpoint_note: RAW_POS reports no firmware temperature setpoint. For tracking comparison reconstruct T_set(t)=35+5*sin(phase_rad) from this metadata and recorded phase_rad. Zero Ta/Tb fields are inactive firmware placeholders, not a 0 C temperature request.
metadata.gain_note: Kp and Ki are zero and unused; no feedback or cooling multiplier is applied. anti_windup=false is inactive in this raw mode.
metadata.safety_note: Existing firmware TEC 10-45 C operating guard, 60 C backup limit and 56 C rod-base guard are unchanged. No hardware commands were sent while preparing this file.
